author: TREY the Explainer
description:
Hey guys! 
I created a quick bonus video discussing some leftover findings I discovered while planning my Steel Ball Run in Real Life race attempt. I found some pretty interesting behind-the-scenes information about JoJo's Bizarre Adventure and the inspirations of Hirohiko Araki from dinosaurs to architecture. 
I hope you enjoy!

Books Highlighted:
Points of Interest: California Views 1860-1870 : The Lawerence & Houseworth Albums
The Art of Bev Doolittle by Bev Doolittle
The American Frontier: Pioneers, Settlers, and Cowboys 1800-1899 by William C. Davis
Reader’s Digest Natural Wonders of the World
The Great Dinosaur Atlas by William Lindsay
Italian Design by Daab
Stilvoll Wohnen by by ARBEITSKREIS DEUTSCHE STILMÖBEL 
X-house: Exceptional Dwellings at the Edge of Design by Sandu Cultural Media
